name: 600 short-cage rear derailleur
weight_description: Manufacturer-listed original Shimano 600 RD-6100 short-cage derailleur, 235 g. The optional long-cage RD-6101 has no separately established weight and is not assigned this figure.

sources.title: Shimano Bicycle System Components, 1981, PDF page 42: RD-6100 identity, configuration and listed specifications
Shimano Bicycle System Components, 1982, PDF page 65 / printed page 62: RD-6100 short-cage specification, total/front/sprocket limits and separate RD-6101 long-cage option
